title: Treble Crochet
description: Learn a tall stitch that builds fabric quickly for open scarves, wraps, and lacy repeats.

content.summary: Yarn over twice before inserting the hook, then work off two loops at a time until one loop remains.
content.whyItMatters: Treble crochet adds height fast, opens the fabric, and helps you understand taller stitch structure.
steps: Insert the hook into the next stitch and pull up a loop.
Yarn over and pull through the first 2 loops.
Yarn over and pull through the next 2 loops.
Yarn over and pull through the final 2 loops.
content.practice: Work 2 rows of 12 treble crochet stitches and compare the height to double crochet.
commonMistakes: Forgetting the second yarn over before inserting the hook.
Pulling the stitch too tight so the tall loops collapse.
